newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria tenders for 75,000 tonnes milling wheat.
newsitem.headline: Algeria tenders for 75,000 tonnes milling wheat.

text.p: Algeria on Monday tendered for 75,000 tonnes of optional-origin milling wheat for shipment in April and May, European grain traders said.
Earlier this month, Algeria bought 75,000 tonnes of wheat, also for April and May, at $174-175 per tonne including cost and freight.
Traders said then that the wheat was paid for in cash and was likely to come from France.
On that occasion, Algeria had tendered for French or Argentine or U.S. wheat, or any combination of the three.
